answer: A sparrow-courier trellis stops clones: a newcomer's first ten jobs are each carried by a different randomly assigned sparrow courier who re-runs the job and stakes 3 POA it was real. The newcomer posts a ferrous bond of 6 POA per job times the square of its position among identities from one wallet: 1st fake 60 POA, 10th 6,000 POA. One courier carries one newcomer per epoch, so clones cannot share couriers, and a failed re-run slashes the bond.
